handlers.body:
int scanline = param;

	if(scanline == 224) // vblank-out irq
		m_maincpu->set_input_line_and_vector(0, HOLD_LINE,0xd7); // Z80 - RST 10h

	if(scanline == 0) // vblank-in irq
		m_maincpu->set_input_line_and_vector(0, HOLD_LINE,0xcf); // Z80 - RST 08h
